zh: *一本关于赫莉莉亚王后的书

text: Shortly after Heliria's arrival on this island, citizens, scholars, and warriors gathered around her. Even the king could not resist her beauty, so they married.
zh: 赫莉莉亚来到这座岛屿后不久，市民、学者与战士便聚集到她的身边。就连国王也无法抗拒她的美貌，于是二人成婚。

text: A scholar from a distant village brought a stone to the queen, who was about to build a new city.
zh: 一位来自遥远村庄的学者向王后献上了一块石头，彼时王后正准备兴建一座新城。

text: After the queen's death, a crypt was built in her honor, in which she is said to rest forever on the lowest level.
zh: 王后逝世后，人们为纪念她修建了一座墓穴。据说她永眠于墓穴的最底层。

text: Her bodyguards, the First of the Royal Guard, were locked up with her so that Queen Heliria would find protection even in death.
zh: 她的贴身护卫——皇家卫队的初代成员——被封入墓中与她相伴，好让赫莉莉亚王后即使在死后也能得到守护。

text: Shortly after the wedding, the king died, leaving behind the queen and a son.
zh: 婚礼后不久，国王便驾崩了，只留下王后和一个儿子。

text:
It was said that the stone shimmered azure blue in the light.
No one can say why this stone was given to her.
zh:
据说那块石头在光下闪着蔚蓝的光泽。
没有人说得清这块石头为何被献给她。

text: All we know is that the queen guarded the stone like her own child and took it with her to #:her grave#:.
zh: 我们只知道，王后如同守护亲生孩子一般守护着那块石头，并将它带进了#:自己的坟墓#:。
